nodes.title: Neural Architectures
nodes.markdown:
# Neural Architectures

A survey of modern neural network architectures used in deep learning.

## Transformer Architecture

The Transformer model, introduced in "Attention is All You Need" (Vaswani et al., 2017), revolutionized NLP by replacing recurrence with self-attention.

```python
class TransformerBlock:
    def __init__(self, d_model=512, n_heads=8):
        self.attention = MultiHeadAttention(d_model, n_heads)
        self.ffn = FeedForward(d_model)
        self.norm1 = LayerNorm(d_model)
        self.norm2 = LayerNorm(d_model)
```

> The key insight is that attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

## Key Components

- **Self-Attention**: Computes relevance scores between all token pairs
- **Feed-Forward Networks**: Position-wise fully connected layers
- **Layer Normalization**: Stabilizes training dynamics
- **Positional Encoding**: Injects sequence order information

See also: [[attention-mechanisms]], [[graph-theories]], [[llm-analytics]]

# Attention Mechanisms

Attention mechanisms allow models to focus on relevant parts of the input.

## Scaled Dot-Product Attention

$$\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V$$

## Multi-Head Attention

Multiple attention heads enable the model to attend to different aspects simultaneously.

Related: [[neural-architectures]], [[bert-pretraining]]

nodes.title: Graph Theories
nodes.markdown:
# Graph Theories

Graph theory in LLM reasoning provides frameworks for understanding knowledge representation.

## Graph Neural Networks

GNNs operate on graph-structured data using message passing.

```python
class GNNLayer:
    def forward(self, x, edge_index):
        messages = self.message(x, edge_index)
        return self.update(x, messages)
```

> The incentive to explore graph-based approaches comes from the observation that many real-world problems have inherent graph structure.

## Applications

- Knowledge graph completion
- Drug discovery
- Social network analysis

Linked: [[neural-architectures]], [[knowledge-graphs]]

nodes.title: BERT: Pre-training
nodes.markdown:
# BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers

**Authors**: Devlin et al., 2019

BERT introduced masked language modeling (MLM) and next sentence prediction (NSP) as pre-training objectives.

```python
def mask_tokens(inputs, tokenizer, mlm_probability=0.15):
    labels = inputs.clone()
    probability_matrix = torch.full(labels.shape, mlm_probability)
    masked_indices = torch.bernoulli(probability_matrix).bool()
    labels[~masked_indices] = -100
    return inputs, labels
```

Related: [[attention-mechanisms]], [[gpt3-architecture]]
